name: TIME dotCom Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约事项；已披露的公告主要涉及季度业绩、股息派发、股东常年大会及关联方交易授权续期等公司治理与资本回报事项。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contract for its business segments; the announcements mainly covered quarterly results, dividend payments, annual general meeting matters, and renewal of the shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions.
